global_qualifications: Bounded independent AI whole-value Romanian linguistic and source-static review only; not native-human review, Android execution, physical-device, layout or whole-locale certification.

All 127 inherited Romanian values and attributes remain unchanged. Existing Salvaţi modificările? retains its inherited spelling and formal/plural register; the new singular imperatives align the existing action-label style without re-reviewing or normalizing that inherited prompt.

Inherited Image format remains English, and Choose location…, Share saved image, Base64 text and the generic failure fallback remain canonical fallbacks. Mixed-language composed UI is explicitly qualified, not certified as a fully localized screen.

Successful export/share writes do not necessarily mark the current document saved or change its ordinary Save destination. The reviewed ui_saved statement is a write-success notification, not a clean-state assertion.
Provider exception messages and user-controlled file display names are substituted content, not translated or linguistically certified by this review.
All five no-current-consumer holds remain absent. No P1, paired-warning oracle, frozen-history, Help callback/archive identity, PR113/PR159, release or other paused scope is reopened.
